text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , O people of Israel; for the Lord has an indictment against the inhabitants of the land. There is no faithfulness or loyalty, and no knowledge of God in the land.
text_cn: 以色列子民，请听上主的话！因为上主谴责此地的居民：因为此地没有诚实，没有仁爱，没有人认识天主；

text_en: Swearing, lying, and murder, and stealing and adultery break out; bloodshed follows bloodshed.
text_cn: 只有诅咒、谎言、杀戮、偷窃、奸淫、强暴和累累的血案。

text_en: Therefore the land mourns, and all who live in it languish; together with the wild animals and the birds of the air, even the fish of the sea are perishing.
text_cn: 因此，此地必要荒废；凡住在这地上的，甚至田间的野兽和天空的飞鸟都要绝迹，连海中的鱼类也要消灭。

text_en: Yet let no one contend, and let none accuse, for with you is my contention, O priest.
text_cn: 但是没有人争辩，也没有人谴责！司祭啊，我要与你争辩！

text_en: You shall stumble by day; the prophet also shall stumble with you by night, and I will destroy your mother.
text_cn: 你白天黑夜跌倒，先知也同你一齐跌倒，你竟然使你的人民丧亡。

text_en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge; because you have rejected knowledge, I reject you from being a priest to me. And since you have forgotten the law of your God, I also will forget your children.
text_cn: 我的百姓因缺乏知识而灭亡；因为你抛弃了知识，我也要抛弃你，不让你充当我的司祭；你既然忘却了你的天主的法律，我也要忘记你的子孙。

text_en: The more they increased, the more they sinned against me; they changed their glory into shame.
text_cn: 司祭越增多，也越得罪我，竟以耻辱作为他们的光荣。

text_en: They feed on the sin of my people; they are greedy for their iniquity.
text_cn: 他们赖我百姓的罪恶自肥，一心渴望他们的过犯。

text_en: And it shall be like people, like priest; I will punish them for their ways, and repay them for their deeds.
text_cn: 因此，百姓和司祭，一律看待：我将按他的行径惩治他，对他的行为予以报复，

text_en: They shall eat, but not be satisfied; they shall play the whore, but not multiply; because they have forsaken the Lord to devote themselves to
text_cn: 好使他们吃，却吃不饱，行淫却不能繁殖；因为他们舍弃了上主，纵欲，

text_en: whoredom. Wine and new wine take away the understanding.
text_cn: 行淫：老酒新酒叫人失去良知。

text_en: My people consult a piece of wood, and their divining rod gives them oracles. For a spirit of whoredom has led them astray, and they have played the whore, forsaking their God.
text_cn: 我的人民求教于木偶，让木杖启示他；因为淫心迷住了他们，使他们行淫，远离了他们的天主。

text_en: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and make offerings upon the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the whore, and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
text_cn: 在山顶上献祭，在丘陵上、在橡树、杨树和笃(dǔ)耨(nòu)香下焚香，在浓荫下多么愉快；因此你们的女儿行淫，你们的儿媳犯奸。

text_en: I will not punish your daughters when they play the whore, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery; for the men themselves go aside with whores, and sacrifice with temple prostitutes; thus a people without understanding comes to ruin.
text_cn: 但我却不因你们的女儿行了淫，而惩罚她们，也不因你们的儿媳犯了奸，而处罚她们；因为他们同荡妇走往偏僻之处，又同庙妓一起献祭：但无智的百姓却因此而堕落！

text_en: Though you play the whore, O Israel, do not let Judah become guilty. Do not enter into Gilgal, or go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear, “As the Lord lives. ”
text_cn: 以色列！如果你行了淫，但愿犹大不要陷于罪恶！你们不要到基耳加耳去，不要上到贝特阿文，也不要起誓说：“上主永在！”

text_en: Like a stubborn heifer, Israel is stubborn; can the Lord now feed them like a lamb in a broad pasture?
text_cn: 的确，以色列倔强，有如一头倔强的母牛，那么上主哪能牧放他们，有如在广阔的草场牧放羔羊？

text_en: Ephraim is joined to idols— let him alone.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因与偶像结了不解之缘：任凭他们吧！

text_en: When their drinking is ended, they indulge in sexual orgies; they love lewdness more than their glory.
text_cn: 他们与醉客为伍，任意荒淫，喜爱羞耻胜于上主的光荣。

text_en: A wind has wrapped them in its wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their altars.
text_cn: 暴风要伸展羽翼将他们卷去，他们必因自己的祭坛蒙受耻辱。
